pending.body: `combine_vss_wallets` can accept and authenticate recovered metadata from fewer than the threshold number of complete VSS shares. At `frozenkrill-core/src/secret_sharing.rs:1205` it builds `verified_inputs` as the intersection of shares whose low and high halves both verify for the winning 24-word candidate, but `frozenkrill-core/src/secret_sharing.rs:1211` only requires that intersection to be non-empty before deriving metadata. For a 3-of-5 24-word wallet, low-half recovery can succeed from shares {1,2,3} while high-half recovery succeeds from {3,4,5}, leaving only share 3 as a complete verified input. Then `derive_metadata` computes `is_duress` from that one input at `frozenkrill-core/src/secret_sharing.rs:1378`/`frozenkrill-core/src/secret_sharing.rs:1385`; a single tampered complete share with `is_duress=true` becomes a strict majority, `authenticate` can still pass because it validates xpub/network via no-passphrase rebuild, and `VssRecovery::rebuild_singlesig` permits passphrase use when `metadata.is_duress` is true at `frozenkrill-core/src/secret_sharing.rs:83`. Require at least the candidate threshold worth of distinct complete verified share identifiers before accepting a candidate and deriving metadata, or otherwise keep metadata unauthenticated so the candidate is rejected.
